title: The Mulberry | Lux Pool/Hot Tub Mins to Old Town
description:
Airlume Stays presents: The Mulberry, a luxurious retreat for the mind and soul. This newly remodeled home has endless possibilities: 6 true bedrooms/3 bathrooms with 10 beds minutes away from Old Town, Spring Training and PHX. Expansive patio with new hot tub and cabana.

Whether you are looking to reunite with friends or enjoy a relaxing getaway with perfect mornings nestled in hotel linens and evenings lounging in our designer cabana, The Mulberry is thoughtfully designed to inspire and calm.

 The space 
Bedroom 1: King Bed with TV | Bedroom 2: Queen Bed with TV | Bedroom 3: Queen Bed with TV | Bedroom 4: Queen Bed with TV | Bedroom 5: 2 Twin Beds | Bedroom 6: 2 Full Beds & 2 Twin Beds with TV

We welcome you to enjoy endless amenities at The Mulberry, not limited to: 
- outdoor cabana to host the ultimate backyard barbecue, complete with propane grill, bar area, ice maker and big-screen cable TV
- heated pool with poolside lounge beds and chairs
- ultra-plush Beautyrest mattresses, two types of pillows and fine hotel linens in every bedroom
- fully equipped chef’s kitchen with coffee station area
- one-of-a-kind media room perfect for late-night binge watching in bed
- spa lotions and shampoos in every bathroom
- outdoor and indoor games
- heated pool 82-84 degrees included*; pool can be heated to 85-90 at additional cost

*pool heating fees may apply to weekday (Monday through Wednesday) bookings. Pool will be heated only from October to March. Any alternative arrangement may result in additional fees.

All Airlume properties have a NO CHORES guarantee: we only expect you to put full garbage bags in our dumpster (assuming you don't want bags of trash lying around your living space). However we will assess additional cleaning charges should there be excessive repair/clean up.

Additional services available for a fee (48-hour advance notice required):
- late check-out, if available (price pending availability)
- early check-in, if available (price pending availability)
- fully-stocked refrigerator
- pay-per-view

License#: 2038650

 Guest access 
The entire property is yours to explore and use during your stay. We ask that guests do not use the rear parking lot as that is where we have the pool equipment which is very sensitive and is therefore monitored.

 Other things to note 
- Entry: Unique Smartlock Code given to enter premises
- each guest over 16 guests will be charged an additional fee of 100.00 per day 
- Checkout Time: Before 10am. Prior arrangements must be made in advance for late checkout, if available an additional fee will be assessed. If parties are not checked out by 12:00pm, an additional night stay will be charged.
- we along with code compliance have a strict policy that ABSOLUTELY no activity is allowed that may result in an item ending up at on a neighbors property: this includes but not limited to: baseball, catch (balls of any kind), any item that ends up in neighbour’s property will be a violation and guests have been warned that neighbors pets can inhale, ingest or be hurt by these items causing bodily harm and/or death and guest will be responsible for any damages causes herein 
- No moving of any furniture or decor, absolutely no glitter or confetti, automatic penalty of $ 500.00 for any evidence of glitter or confetti plus additional damage fees and/or cleaning may apply 
- House Restrictions: No house parties, No loud music, No events --- NoiseAware sensors are set up at the house and any complaints from neighbors and/or authorities will result in automatic checkout and forfeiture of security deposit. NoiseAware is a decibel monitoring system that we use to keep in accordance with local noise regulations. Disclaimer: Nest video system has been installed at the front door and driveway of the house for EXTERIOR ONLY, for your safety. 1000.00 fine for code enforcement visit 
- Equipment: Please do not remove pool vacuum, or fee will be assessed. If there are any issues, please feel free to call us.
- Smoking/Drugs: The house has a strict no smoking or vaping inside the home, smoking is allowed in backyard area, please make sure doors and windows are closed. If any evidence of smoking, vaping or use of illegal substances is detected on the premises, guests will be automatically checked out, face forfeiture of the stay , an automatic penalty of $2500.00 will apply along with additional damages and need for commercial purification services may also apply
- Pet Policy: Due to pet allergies of future guests and our cleaners, we have a strict NO pets policy which unfortunately also extends to NO service animals, there will be an automatic fine of $2500.00 plus any damages and/ or additional cleaning fees may apply ,outside cameras monitor all occupants entering into home 
- Children/Minors: Must be accompanied at all times when outside due to the risks posed by the pool. Life jackets and flotation devices are available. Any guests under the age of 18 must be disclosed; pool alarms are required by law to be on every entry/exit to the pool, they will be activated prior to stay any tampering or disabling of these pool alarms is a violation and absolves the host of any liability, if there are any issues on pool alarms and each guest is to check that they are all functioning and in the rare chance they are not, guest must report immediately to host 
- No GLITTER OR CONFETTI, NO DECOR can be affixed to walls or furniture, 1000.00 penalty
- No outside vendors without prior approval and insurance on file, NO HIBACHI, these services are strictly prohibited and an automatic $2500 fine will be assessed along with damages and excessive cleaning 
- No glass bottles allowed near pool
- coffee: each house has a coffee machine (please ask type) few pods are provided as a starter and guests will order more for their stay
- Number of Guests: May not exceed 16 guests. If there are more than 16 guests sensed by Nest systems, it will result in automatic checkout and
 forfeiture of security deposit. The 
correct number of guests must be reported prior to the time of check in as we will not have the correct number of supplies should that number of guests exceed the registered number, if additional guests are attending, prior approval is necessary from management
- Guests are not to mail any personal items to the property address, Host is NOT responsible for any lost items and items may arrive early interfering with other guests who may be at the property
-hot tub/ pool heating fee of $150 a night may apply if outside pool heating season or reservation does not include a weekend, additional charges may occur for any changes, temperature are set to 82 for pool, spa and pool heat is unavailable from June 1st to October 1st, or anytime temperatures average over 85 during stay

- SUMMER GUESTS: June 1st to October 1st: please note that excessive heat warnings and very high temperatures are the normal and with that AC units are limited to maintain temperature around 72-74 inside, doors to the exterior must not be left opened to avoid extreme heat to come inside, 
Our rates are significantly reduced in the summer and we want to be very transparent on the temperatures/heat warnings and the affects it can have on your stay, during this time the hot tub will be disabled to ensure health and safety along with pool heat, and lastly Arizona summers also bring our seasonal pests, despite monthly pest control, you may unfortunately witness them still, we want you to have an amazing time, however we believe in full transparency always, as this does not just relate to our stays but to the region in general and we always want our guests to be fully informed
- Excessive Cleaning charges will apply for instances where makeup or other substances cannot be removed off linens and towels and excessive garbage is found throughout the house along with strong odors, any evidence of vomit and blood will result in a minimum $500.00 fine
amenities: 66 inch HDTV with Fire TV, standard cable
Children’s books and toys for ages 5-10 years old and 10+ years old
Private outdoor pool - available all year, open 24 hours, heated
